scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n worker,server,client "pnpm run dev:worker" "pnpm run dev:server" "pnpm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: mkdir -p dist/client && wait-on --timeout 30000 dist/worker/index.mjs && pnpm --dir runtime exec cf dev --port 3000
scripts.build: pnpm run types && pnpm run build:worker && pnpm run build:client && pnpm --dir runtime exec cf build
scripts.types: pnpm --dir runtime exec cf workers types
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir runtime exec cf dev --port 3000
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir runtime exec cf deploy --prebuilt
scripts.deploy:preview: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir runtime exec wrangler deploy --name id-marketing-preview --domain preview.dlbr.app --config ../wrangler.jsonc
